# temps_email_provider (Resource)

An email service Temps sends through: Amazon SES, Scaleway, or any SMTP relay. Give the credentials for `provider_type` in the matching `*_credentials` argument.

Import with `<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `email_providers:read`, `email_providers:create`, `email_providers:write`, `email_providers:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_email_provider" "smtp" {
  name          = "Relay"
  provider_type = "smtp"
  region        = "eu-west-1"
  smtp_credentials = jsonencode({
    host     = "smtp.example.com"
    port     = 587
    username = "temps"
    password = var.smtp_password
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the provider.
- `provider_type` (String) Email service. One of `ses`, `scaleway`, `smtp`.
- `region` (String) Service region, for example `eu-west-1`.

### Optional

- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether Temps sends through the provider.
- `scaleway_credentials` (String, Sensitive) Scaleway credentials: `jsonencode({ api_key = ..., project_id = ... })`. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.
- `ses_credentials` (String, Sensitive) SES credentials: `jsonencode({ access_key_id = ..., secret_access_key = ... })`. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.
- `smtp_credentials` (String, Sensitive) SMTP relay: `jsonencode({ host = ..., port = 587, username = ..., password = ... })`. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.
- `sns_topic_arn` (String) SNS topic SES reports bounces and complaints to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id>
terraform import temps_email_provider.smtp 1
```
